coupling: The date commit routes Date formatting through HeapStringAllocator while preserving the formatted result. The stream commit changes HeapStringAllocator::grow to allocate one byte less than the capacity it reports. Neither edit alone overflows the date probe: the date-only tree keeps the original allocator/grow logic, and the stream-only tree keeps the original date allocator. Together, a normal Date.prototype.toString grows the heap buffer to a reported 32 bytes while allocating only 31, so the stream copy crosses the allocation boundary.
